text:
Evan: Hey team — quick thought: sunset harbor boat ride + cocktails next Thurs 7pm? small group, BYO jacket. Who's interested? @here
Mina: Ooh that sounds lovely. I'm in if its under $40.
Theo: In! Happy to help coordinate tickets. How many seats do we need?
Sofia: Depends on how many come. Id prefer ground-level bar afterwards instead of crowded boat.
Rex: I have a friend with a small private sailboat, could be cheaper but weather-dependent. Also, i'm allergic to shellfish fyi.
Evan: Good note, Rex. We'll avoid shrimp-heavy catering. Theo: can you spin up a quick poll for ticket vs private sail?
Theo: /poll "Which option?" "Public boat ride ($35)" "Private sail (weather backup)" "Bar only (7:30pm)"
calendar-bot: Poll posted: Which option? Votes open until Tue 3pm.
Mina: voted public boat. Also can we do a 6-seat cap per person on plus-ones? trying to keep it small.
Sofia: voted bar only (depends on schedule).
Theo: If public wins i'll prebook 12 spots and set a refundable hold.
Evan: Plan if split: public boat for early comers + bar meetup after. If private sail wins we'll do a rain plan to bar.
Rex: sounds great. i can bring an extra blanket and emergency umbrella. :umbrella:
Mina: i'm bringing a non-alcoholic cocktail mix for drivers.
Sofia: can we confirm docking spot and transport options once booked? i'm carpooling.
Evan: will post final details after poll closes. low-key, no pressure. :sun_with_face:
